name: component with form 20662
styles: .hm-form{max-width:var(--hf-max,640px);margin:0 auto 64px;text-align:left;color:#fff;font-family:'Saira','Helvetica Neue',Arial,sans-serif}.hm-form .jet-form-builder{color:#fff}.hm-form .jet-form-builder-row{margin:0 0 28px}.hm-form .jet-form-builder__label,.hm-form .jet-form-builder__label-text{font-family:inherit;font-size:13px;font-weight:500;letter-spacing:.2em;text-transform:uppercase;color:rgba(255,255,255,.6);margin:0 0 6px}.hm-form .jet-form-builder__required{color:rgba(255,255,255,.6)}.hm-form .jet-form-builder__desc:empty{display:none}.hm-form input.jet-form-builder__field,.hm-form textarea.jet-form-builder__field{display:block;width:100%;box-sizing:border-box;background:transparent!important;color:#fff!important;border:0!important;border-bottom:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.4)!important;border-radius:0!important;box-shadow:none!important;outline:none;padding:10px 0!important;font-family:inherit;font-size:18px;font-weight:300;line-height:1.5;transition:border-color .2s ease}.hm-form textarea.jet-form-builder__field{min-height:140px;resize:vertical}.hm-form input.jet-form-builder__field:focus,.hm-form textarea.jet-form-builder__field:focus{border-bottom-color:#fff!important}.hm-form input[type=file]{width:100%;color:rgba(255,255,255,.7);font-family:inherit;font-size:14px;background:transparent!important;border:0!important;padding:6px 0!important}.hm-form input[type=file]::file-selector-button{margin-right:14px;padding:10px 18px;background:transparent;color:#fff;border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.6);border-radius:0;font-family:inherit;font-size:12px;font-weight:500;letter-spacing:.15em;text-transform:uppercase;cursor:pointer;transition:background .2s ease,color .2s ease}.hm-form input[type=file]::file-selector-button:hover{background:#fff;color:#0b0b0b}.hm-form .jet-form-builder-file-upload__message,.hm-form .jet-form-builder__field-wrap small,.hm-form .jet-form-builder-file-upload__errors{color:rgba(255,255,255,.55);font-size:13px}.hm-form .jet-form-builder__submit,.hm-form .jet-form-builder__action-button,.hm-form button[type=submit]{display:inline-block;background:transparent!important;color:#fff!important;border:1px solid #fff!important;border-radius:0!important;box-shadow:none!important;padding:16px 40px!important;font-family:inherit;font-size:13px;font-weight:500;letter-spacing:.25em;text-transform:uppercase;cursor:pointer;transition:background .2s ease,color .2s ease}.hm-form .jet-form-builder__submit:hover,.hm-form .jet-form-builder__submit:focus,.hm-form .jet-form-builder__action-button:hover,.hm-form .jet-form-builder__action-button:focus,.hm-form button[type=submit]:hover,.hm-form button[type=submit]:focus{background:#fff!important;color:#0b0b0b!important}.hm-form .jet-form-builder__submit:focus-visible,.hm-form button[type=submit]:focus-visible{outline:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.45);outline-offset:4px}.hm-form p{font-size:13px;line-height:1.6;color:rgba(255,255,255,.55);margin:20px 0 0}.hm-form p a{color:#fff;text-decoration:underline}.hm-form .jet-form-builder-messages-wrap,.hm-form .jet-form-builder-message{color:#fff!important;background:transparent!important;border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.4)!important;border-radius:0!important;padding:14px 18px!important;margin:20px 0 0;font-size:15px}.hm-form .error-message,.hm-form .jet-form-builder-col__error{color:#fff;font-size:13px;margin-top:6px}.hm-form .field-has-error input.jet-form-builder__field,.hm-form .field-has-error textarea.jet-form-builder__field{border-bottom-color:#fff!important;border-bottom-width:2px!important}.hm-form .jet-form-builder-messages-wrap:empty{display:none!important}.hm-form input.jet-form-builder__field.file-field{border-bottom:0!important;padding:6px 0!important;font-size:14px;color:rgba(255,255,255,.7)!important}.hm-form .jet-form-builder-file-upload__content{min-height:0;min-width:0;display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:10px}
